# Captured 2026-09-04 on K3s v1.35.5+k3s1 via k3d.
# Mechanism: built-in Pod Security Admission at 'restricted' (namespace

# captures its rejection separately -- the two are different mechanisms
# and proving one says nothing about the other.
#
# Command:
#   kubectl -n hsm-pki-dev apply -f deploy/k8s/policy/testdata/insecure-pod.yaml
#
# Result: rejected, and 'kubectl get pod insecure-pod' reports NotFound --
# nothing was created, so this is a refusal rather than a warning.

forbidden: violates PodSecurity "restricted:latest": host namespaces 
(hostNetwork=true, hostPID=true), privileged (container "insecure" must not

(container "insecure" must set

(container "insecure" must set securityContext.capabilities.drop=["ALL"]; 
container "insecure" must not include "NET_ADMIN", "SYS_ADMIN" in 
securityContext.capabilities.add), restricted volume types (volume 
"host-root" uses restricted volume type "hostPath"), runAsNonRoot != true 
(pod or container "insecure" must set securityContext.runAsNonRoot=true),
